en: Theragāthā 1.109 Ekakanipāta Ekādasamavagga (The Eleventh Chapter of the Single Verses)
The Verses of the Elder Saṅgharakkhita:
“Surely he who is compassionate for the supreme welfare of others does not,
having gone into solitude, disregard the teaching;”
"For he dwells thus with his faculties unguarded, like a young doe in the forest. ...
